purpose: Bind the existing Triggerword-4 live-indeterminate-effect repair losslessly so it can be reviewed and executed without silently reusing the v1 API identity. This record is not current authority until the source delta is admitted and a current-main attestation promotes it.

api_contract.effect_gate_call: EffectGate.execute(req, episode_id=None, lease=None) -> (effect_id, outcome) or raises a typed terminal-boundary exception
api_contract.live_unknown_rule: If EntityOS invocation may have crossed the causal child-start boundary but no trustworthy terminal receipt exists, canonical state is UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH, credit remains zero, and blind replay is forbidden. It must never be collapsed to FAILED or VERIFIED.
api_contract.restart_unknown_rule: UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART remains a distinct recovery classification for a persisted PENDING effect discovered after restart; it is not an alias for live dispatch uncertainty.
api_contract.definite_failure_rule: Integrity/admission failures and subprocess launch/exec-handshake errors raised before subprocess.Popen returns are pre-dispatch failures and are not promoted to UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH.
api_contract.causal_boundary_note: The candidate EntityOSBridge now uses successful subprocess.Popen return as the causal execution boundary. A Popen launch/exec-handshake exception remains definite pre-dispatch failure; after Popen returns, timeout, transport, communicate, or terminal-receipt processing failure is conservatively EntityOSOutcomeUnknown because the child may already have produced an external effect. Best-effort kill/reap contains the process but does not mint a negative world fact.

required_fail_closed_invariants: EffectGate remains the sole canonical real-effect gate and EffectJournal remains the canonical effect journal
caller does not mint canonical effect_id

successful subprocess.Popen return is the child-start causal boundary for live outcome uncertainty

EntityOSOutcomeUnknown becomes UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH with zero credit

UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART remains separately represented and cannot authorize automatic retry
EntityOSIntegrityError and other established pre-dispatch failures are not silently upgraded to UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH

frankenstein2_consumption.rule: F2 must not consume this candidate as current canonical authority. After admission/current-main attestation, the active WP105 lane may translate its local ExecutorOutcomeUnknown into the canonical EntityOSOutcomeUnknown only at the integration boundary, preserve the complete v2 authority identity, and prove UNKNOWN causes no blind replay or second executor path.

Preserve the complete multi-source identity tuple, then admit/merge the source delta and create a successor current-main attestation with post-merge blobs and API version. Only after that may active F2-WP-105 consume the live UNKNOWN contract in its deterministic no-real-effect matrix.
